 80 percent of the early bets on DraftKings back Lilli Tagger to beat Tereza Valentova in their second career showdown in Osaka.
 Current Form:
 Tereza Valentova made her triumphant return to the WTA Tour after skipping major events in the Asian swing due to hip and back issues. Banking on her terrific baseline game, Valentova fended off a late fightback from Zhang Shuai 6-2, 1-6, 6-4, to reach the second round in Osaka.
 Lilli Tagger snapped a three-match losing streak with a clinical win over Liudmila Samsonova 6-3, 6-3. Tagger protected her service games by winning 81 percent of her first serves while breaking the big-serving Samsonova three times.
 The Matchup: Valentova posted a 7-5, 7-5 win over Tagger in their first meeting on the red clay of Saint-Malo in France earlier this year.
